name: GS2Mesh
definition: A surface reconstruction method that extracts geometry from 3D Gaussian Splatting by rendering stereo-aligned image pairs and feeding them into a pre-trained stereo-matching model to obtain depth profiles, which are then fused into a mesh.
summary: GS2Mesh extracts smooth 3D meshes from Gaussian Splatting by rendering stereo pairs and fusing depth via a pre-trained stereo model, avoiding the noise inherent in direct Gaussian optimization.
